package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<a href="https://example.com" title="Example Site">Example</a>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
